sanskrit: paripṛcchatyumādevī ekānte jñānamuttamamkathayasva purābhedaṃ kulānandeṣu cottamamsadyaḥ pratyayakārakaṃ yathā dehe vyavasthitamsarvaṃ tattu sureśvara kathayasva mama prabhoetat kaulikaṃ jñānaṃ kulānande cāṣṭottamaḥtatraiva manasā rodhya lakṣayeddīpaśikhān vratītena lakṣitamātreṇa jāyate siddhiruttamātathā coparitiṣṭhati devo bhairavo jagatprabhuḥjāyate dhvanibhirjātiṃ tatra marudviśeṣataḥjāyate paramaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryavicāraṇāttaṃ pravakṣyāmi he devi śṛṇuṣvāyatalocanetatraiva sthāpayedvittaṃ kathitaṃ jāyate dhruvamtatraivotpādayet sṛṣṭiṃ tīvrajyotiḥsamākṛtiḥpāśastobhaṃ karotyevaṃ yadi viśramate manaḥjvalajvālanamadhyasthaṃ dvijagranthi nirīkṣayetsṛṣṭiṃ pravartante devi nātra kāryavicāraṇātkathayasva viśeṣeṇa yathā jānāmi tatkṣaṇātbrahmasthāne.....padmaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidalānvitambhedayitvā mahāgranthiṃ dvicakrañca tathaiva cacalantaṃ bhrāmayettena niyataṃ tu mahītaleyāvadviśramate nityaṃ bhramate cakravat śiraḥvāmasrotaṃ tu yāvat tīvratejasamaprabhametanme saṃśayo deva kathayasva mama prabhomadhyataḥpalitāstambhayeddevi māsamekena suvrate

sanskrit: yatra catuṣpathasthānaṃ tatra sarvāsurālayamaśrutāṃ vadate bālāṃ...........ḍivya varānanetataḥ parataraṃ sthānaṃ tatra sarve pravartatejvalajjvalanasaṃdhyasthaṃ tatraiva lakṣayeddevivedhayedvicakṣaṇaḥ vedhayitvā tu taṃ lakṣayetdevāsuramanujānāṃ durlabho bhavati sādhakaḥtataścāpi saṃśayo deva kathayasva mama prabhoyā sā mahāvahā nāḍī kucelyākārasaṃsthitāhṛccakra............... tīvraśakti suvigrahāathānyaṃ paramaṃ devi khecaratvaṃ śṛṇu priyenavāhamabhṛtaṃ dadaitaḥ (?)yāvad......ṣthāneṣu khyātā tasya mayāgrataḥjvalanārūḍhaṃ kṛtvā caturthaṃ svarasaṃyutaḥvargātītaṃ punardevi ṣaṣṭhasvaravibhūṣitaḥvargasya prathamaṃ bījaṃ sṛṣṭerādyato yojayetnityaṃ tu yojayeddevi ekacittastu paṇḍitaḥbhagasya madhyastha bhagamadho hutāśanamvisantu cintayeddevi sṛṣṭikamalantu yāvatbhavanti vihvalā nāryaḥ kṣaṇamekena suvrateśṛṇuyāt paramādevi aghoravikramātejasākarṣayet tu.....cittaṃ susaryataḥsaṃgamānmokṣahetukaṃ .................................āsanaṃ tu sthitaṃ kṛtvā........viśva anivṛttaḥcittaṃ tatra sthitaṃ kṛtvā khamadhye viniyojayetetadvijñānamātreṇa gīyate tatra madhyataḥ
